description: Resolve a concrete project version or `latest` to documentation and artifact URLs. Discover valid version strings with list_versions first. Save resolved_version and, when present, revision_id. Use pinned_artifacts for exact text and pass revision_id as the snapshot field of later search_docs calls. Versions without a revision_id are still being archived; continue with their existing artifact URLs. Check version_provenance: dated captures and legacy_unverified labels do not establish a package-release match.
name: resolve_docs
